{{Top|leg}}
A '''trachea''' was a part of a [[Human/Legends|Human's]] anatomy, located in the [[Throat/Legends|throat]]. Each Human had only a single trachea. When an individual was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Choking powers|Force choked]], the trachea was often compressed, which could be fatal.
